answer: One concrete defense is a public work trail tied to a refundable bond: before an agent takes valuable jobs, it must finish small, useful tasks anyone can inspect, like facets of a crystal, and lock a bond forfeited if it cheats. A sybil attacker can mint a thousand identities, but each must separately earn its trail, so the cost multiplies with every fake. A mirror identity with no history is easy to spot: no completed work, no one to vouch for it. Each agent signs its work with a private cipher key, so a good record cannot be copied to a fresh identity.
